description: This PHP source file defines the I18NTranslationValidationAPI class, which provides an API endpoint for validating internationalization translation strings within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for handling GET requests to validate translation strings, along with validation rules and unimplemented methods for update and delete operations.

classes.name: I18NTranslationValidationAPI
classes.description: API class for validating internationalization translation strings, extending Endpoint and implementing ResourceEndpoint.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to validate a specific translation string by ID and translation text.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne method, including checks for positive ID and existing entity, and optional string length validation.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Unimplemented method for updating translation validation, throws not implemented exception.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Unimplemented method for validation rules for update, throws not implemented exception.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Unimplemented method for deleting translation validation, throws not implemented exception.

methods.description: Unimplemented method for validation rules for delete, throws not implemented exception.
